# IPTV List

> IPTV List is a subscription IPTV service built around itemized disclosure — the actual channel and VOD count, the actual device compatibility list, and the actual per-plan price, posted before you are asked for any payment details, instead of vague marketing claims like "thousands of channels" or "works on everything." Plans include 40,000+ live channels and 180,000+ VOD titles, identical across every plan length — a longer term lowers the price, it never unlocks extra content. Subscriptions run 1, 3, 6, or 12 months ($14.99 / $34.99 / $54.99 / $79.99 USD), with a $1.00 24-hour trial available before committing, running the identical live catalog a paying subscriber gets. Compatible with Smart TVs, Android TV, Fire TV, Android and iOS devices, Apple TV, Windows, and macOS.
